title: Comparison of Pre-procedural PCR and Culture-based UTI Assessment Prior to Intravesical Botox Injection
brief_summary: This study is a retrospective record review to determine whether a novel multiplex PCR assay can be utilized as a screening method for UTI in patients receiving Botox injection to treat overactive bladder (OAB).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject is male or female
* \>18 years of age at date of injection
* Subject receiving BoNT injection for symptoms of OAB (including urgency, urinary incontinence, and detrusor overactivity) refractory to first-line therapies
study_population: Patients receiving Botox injections for the treatment of neurogenic or non-neurogenic OAB
